entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: Powerful and jealous wizards and planeswalkers who fought the Tolgath in the Great War.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: A younger group of wizards who battled the Ancients.

entities.name: Great War
entities.description: Interplanar war between the Ancients and the Tolgath.

entities.name: Great Destruction
entities.description: The end of the war on Ulgrotha when the battle was joined.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where the Great Destruction occurred.

entities.name: Rift
entities.description: Created on Ulgrotha by one of the Ancients.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Artifact rung by Ravi, which destroyed many of the Ancients.

events.summary: The Great War ended in the Great Destruction on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: The war ended in the Great Destruction on the plane of Ulgrotha when their battle was joined.

events.summary: One of the Ancients created the Rift on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: One of the Ancients created the Rift on Ulgrotha.

events.summary: Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime, probably destroying many of the Ancients.
events.quote: many, if not all, were destroyed when Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

relations.note: They fought in the Great War.
relations.quote: battled the younger group of wizards, the Tolgath , in the interplanar Great War
